approx.description: In `resolve`: found by approximation or fallback.

contextChanged.description:
In `resolve`, for a stored selector: the quote was located exactly
but the stored `prefix` and `suffix` are not reproduced there, or,
for a symbol that names one declaration, the quote is not found in it
at all, neither exactly nor by the fuzzy step.

key.description: Unique within the resource. Stable while the unit is the same unit.

parent.description: Key of the enclosing unit. Absent on the wire means `null`.

range.description: Omitted when the resource is not text.

refuse.description: In `resolve`: must not be used to create a claim or replace a side.

sel.description:
A selector that, sent to `resolve` with the same `loc`, returns
exactly this unit now.

Range.description:
A unit's place in a text resource (section 4.2): UTF-8 byte offsets,
`start` inclusive, `end` exclusive, 1-based lines.

Refuse.description: Why a resolution must not be used to create a claim or replace a side.

Selector.description: A selector (spec section 5.2). No key may be null.

key.description: A unit key, for providers that address units by key.

pos.description: Byte offset of the quote when it was recorded. A hint only.

prefix.description: Up to 48 characters that preceded the quote.

quote.description:
Text that occurs in the unit. At most 2,048 characters, and not
only whitespace.

suffix.description: Up to 48 characters that followed the quote.

symbol.description: Declaration path in a code resource.
